title: Liberalism Resurgent
author: Modern
content:
LIBERALISM RESURGENT:

A Response to the Right

© Copyright by 
Steve Kangas,
 editor.

Welcome to the web site that stands up for liberalism. More than ever before, 
opponents of liberalism are broadcasting pseudo-science, demagogic politics, 
crank economics, and think-tank propaganda in easily parrotted
sound bites. This site is a gateway to an entire arsenal of liberal studies, 
statistics and state-of-the-art arguments that refute their myths.
Form your own opinions from 
credible
 sources such as mainstream scholars and
the National Academy of Sciences, and benefit from a more complete picture
than you normally find on the mass market.

Help Fight the Right!
 -- Support Liberalism Resurgent in the fight against corporate tyranny.

The Short FAQ on Liberalism
 -- A quick but 
extensive overview of the tenets of liberalism, designed to correct the many 
myths propagated by its critics.

The Long FAQ on Liberalism
 -- An 
encyclopedia of liberal arguments, debunking nearly 120 common political myths 
with the latest studies, statistics and arguments.

The Reagan Years: A Statistical
Overview
 -- Over 150 charts debunking the Reagan Myth and supply-side 
economics. Includes an in-depth statistical comparison of the United States 
to other rich (and more liberal) countries, showing how the U.S. comes in 
last on almost every important list.

The Great Depression: Its Causes
and Cure
 -- Includes a detailed timeline of the Roaring 20s and the Great Depression, 
rebutting the myth that government intervention was the cause for 
America's worst economic disaster.

The Origins of the Overclass
 -- Reveals why the richest 1 percent have exploded ahead since 1975, with the help of the New Right, Corporate America and, surprisingly, the CIA.

A Timeline of CIA Atrocities
 -- This history of the CIA will shock you, and have you calling for instant reform.

The Real Significance of the Year 2000
 
-- It's not just a meaningless turning over of the odometer. Check out the daunting challenges and problems of the 
New Era.

Income Inequality and Social Problems

-- Harvard and Berkeley prove the correlation! Their studies of income inequality 
in all 50 states showed a strong association to mortality rates, crime, poor 
educational outcomes, substance abuse, etc. An important read.

Activism in Three Easy Steps
 -- And
you thought fighting the good fight was hopeless! This essay describes a super-quick and 
efficient strategy for political activism for those who already lead busy and 
exciting lives.

Government Success Stories
and Free-Market Failures
 -- For those who think markets are magical. Read about
the success of Eisenhower's interstate highway program, and the Ford Pintos that exploded
on them.

"Why Socialism?" by Albert Einstein
 -- An 
indictment of capitalism by the 20th century's first long-haired leftist.

Steve's Ultimate Reading List for Liberals

-- The best books in my library of hundreds.

Favorite Quotes
 -- Over 200 of my favorite 
quotes on politics, science, religion, and many other topics.

Liberal Reasons Not to Celebrate 
Christmas
 -- Agree or disagree, the following reasons are well-supported and will 
cause you to consider Christmas in a whole new light.

A Glossary of Political and Economic Terms
 -- A 
glossary for terms both common and not. Ever 
wonder what the difference between "socialism" and "communism" is?

Historical Economic
Statistics
 -- A one-stop reference source for the most frequently
used statistics in the debate.

Links to Other Political Sites, Version 2
 -- My new, updated and 
expanded list of links.

Links to Other Political Sites, Version 1
 -- My old list of links, which 
some may prefer.

Credits, Raves and Raspberries
 -- The readers' 
response to this website, including awards, critiques and a credit list of all those 
who helped improve this site.
